description: Curated OpenCPN resource expectations for the S-64-inspired traditional point scene

features.note: Traditional point mode should resolve the generic paper buoy row without extra buoy-shape attributes.
Traditional soundings use the paper-table conditional CS(SOUNDG02).
Traditional point wreck rendering uses the paper-table conditional.

crops.name: buoy_symbol
crops.note: Traditional buoy crop should contain a paper-style buoy glyph.

crops.name: sounding_symbol
crops.note: Soundings are enabled in this scene and should produce a visible crop.

crops.name: danger_symbol
crops.note: Traditional wreck crop should contain a visible danger symbol.
